title: Last Bell, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: School lets out. He hasn't been in it for a year. He drives past anyway.

panels.composition: Small Wood High from the road, 3:05 PM. The bell. Kids pouring out. WOOD's Datsun slowing on the road, BARNABY's head out the window.

image.prompt: a small-town high school seen from the road as students pour out at the last bell, an old Datsun slowing on the road with a small dog's head out the window, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Wood, watching the steps. Three kids sitting on them, not moving. Not his three.
props: three unknown kids on the steps

image.prompt: close-up through a car window of a young man watching three unfamiliar teenagers sitting on school steps

panels.composition: Barnaby, to Wood, in the way dogs are.

balloons.text: I know. It's a school. I'm not sentimental about a school.

image.prompt: a small dog in a car looking at the young man driving, who is talking to it defensively

panels.composition: The Datsun pulling away toward the bay. The school small in the mirror. The strip does not draw the three on the steps again.
props: rear-view mirror with the school small in it

image.prompt: an old Datsun driving away down a road toward a bay, a school small in the rear-view mirror, black and white, no words
